why: B's hypotheses are exactly the fields of a LocalDetChart, so A => B instantiates A at that chart: y := ySol, Φ(S,k) = (S, kerMap S k) with inverse (S,x) ↦ (S, kerProj x) (A's third and fourth conjuncts), continuous by A's first conjunct and continuity of kerProj (kerProj is definitionally B's projectionOnto). B => A: B's y equals the project's ySol on ball × ker(PT) (both lie in Y and solve PS(k+y) = 0; PS|_Y injective on the ball), which gives A's second conjunct; A's third follows from Φ∘Φ⁻¹ = id; A's first (continuity on ball × E rather than ball × ker(PT)) from B's joint continuity plus kerMap S x = kerMap S (kerProj x) on the ball. The only part of A not in B is the fourth conjunct for S OUTSIDE the ball (kerProj (kerMap S k) = k for every S, a property of the project's junk extension of ySol), proved directly from ySol_mem; it carries no content of the text.
